title: IAM Access Key Audit
description: Reports every IAM user access key with its age, when it was last used, and whether it has ever been used at all. Read-only: it disables nothing.

inputs.label: AWS region
inputs.help: One region per run. Bucket and IAM listings are account-wide; EC2 resources are per-region.

inputs.label: Key age threshold (days)
inputs.help: Keys older than this are flagged. Rotation policies are commonly 90 days.

nodes.label: Audit IAM access keys
nodes.value:
import json
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

# A step with no cloud integration bound reaches signing time and raises
# NoCredentialsError as a bare traceback. The agent would then file that
# traceback as an observation. Fail here instead, with a sentence that names
# what is missing and who fixes it.
_creds = boto3.session.Session().get_credentials()
if _creds is None:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "No AWS credentials reached this step. Bind an AWS cloud "
                               "integration to this automation under Cloud Integrations, "
                               "and make sure it is available to this project."}))
    raise SystemExit(1)

MAX_AGE = int("{{MaxKeyAgeDays}}")
iam = boto3.session.Session(region_name="{{Region}}").client("iam")
now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)


def age_days(ts):
    return (now - ts).days if ts else None


out = {"maxKeyAgeDays": MAX_AGE, "users": [], "errors": []}

for page in iam.get_paginator("list_users").paginate():
    for user in page["Users"]:
        name = user["UserName"]
        entry = {"user": name, "keys": []}
        try:
            for key in iam.list_access_keys(UserName=name)["AccessKeyMetadata"]:
                key_id = key["AccessKeyId"]
                # LastUsedDate is ABSENT when a key has never been used, which
                # is a different finding from "used, but a long time ago".
                used = iam.get_access_key_last_used(AccessKeyId=key_id) \
                          .get("AccessKeyLastUsed", {})
                last = used.get("LastUsedDate")
                created = age_days(key["CreateDate"])
                entry["keys"].append({
                    "keyId": key_id,
                    "status": key["Status"],
                    "ageDays": created,
                    "lastUsedDays": age_days(last),
                    "neverUsed": last is None,
                    "lastService": used.get("ServiceName"),
                    "overAge": (created or 0) > MAX_AGE,
                })
        except ClientError as e:
            out["errors"].append({"user": name, "error": e.response["Error"]["Code"]})
            continue
        if entry["keys"]:
            out["users"].append(entry)

keys = [k for u in out["users"] for k in u["keys"]]
out["summary"] = {
    "users": len(out["users"]),
    "keys": len(keys),
    "activeOverAge": sum(1 for k in keys if k["overAge"] and k["status"] == "Active"),
    "activeNeverUsed": sum(1 for k in keys if k["neverUsed"] and k["status"] == "Active"),
}
print(json.dumps(out, indent=2))

requires.customerText: An AWS cloud integration available to this project, with read-only permission for: iam:ListUsers, iam:ListAccessKeys, iam:GetAccessKeyLastUsed
